items.source: This generic servlet base class has no dependency on the Spring ApplicationContext concept. Simple servlets usually don't load their own context but rather access service beans from the Spring root application context, accessible via the filter's ServletContext (see WebApplicationContextUtils).
items.translation: 这个通用 Servlet 基类不依赖于 Spring `ApplicationContext` 概念。简单的 Servlet 通常不会加载自己的上下文，而是通过过滤器中的 `ServletContext`（参见 `WebApplicationContextUtils`）访问 Spring 根应用程序上下文中的服务 Bean。

items.source: The FrameworkServlet class is a more specific servlet base class which loads its own application context. FrameworkServlet serves as direct base class of Spring's full-fledged DispatcherServlet.
items.translation: `FrameworkServlet` 类是一个更具体的 servlet 基类，它加载自己的应用程序上下文。`FrameworkServlet` 充当 Spring 完整的 `DispatcherServlet` 的直接基类。

items.source: This servlet leaves request handling to subclasses, inheriting the default behavior of HttpServlet (doGet, doPost, etc).
items.translation: 此 Servlet 将请求处理留给子类，继承自 HttpServlet 的默认行为（`doGet`、`doPost` 等）。

items.source:
A handy superclass for any type of servlet. Type conversion of config
parameters is automatic, with the corresponding setter method getting
invoked with the converted value. It is also possible for subclasses to
specify required properties. Parameters without matching bean property
setter will simply be ignored.
items.translation: 适用于任何类型 Servlet 的便捷父类。配置参数的类型转换是自动进行的，相应的 setter 方法将使用转换后的值被调用。子类也可以指定必需属性。没有匹配 Bean 属性 setter 的参数将被简单地忽略。
